lines.en: All the songs, all the stars,
all the eyes weep as you go.
All the flowers, all the leaves,
all the rivers carry sad waters.
Oh, oh,
I stand alone in my yard,

lines.cyr: ај, стојам сама, ај јас во дворој,
lines.lat: aj, stojam sama, aj jas vo dvoroj,
lines.en: oh, I stand alone, oh in my yard,
your words drip into my heart.
You are leaving, you are leaving
and you leave me empty days.

lines.cyr: Но и ти ќе си сам,
lines.lat: No i ti ḱe si sam,
lines.en: But you too will be alone,
to whom shall I give my dreams?
If you would give me a little hope,

lines.cyr: за да тлеат в' срце две-три траги,
lines.lat: za da tleat v' srce dve-tri tragi,
lines.en: so that two or three traces smolder in my heart,
like a song, like spring,

lines.cyr: да те чекам преку сите таги.
lines.lat: da te čekam preku site tagi.
lines.en: I would wait for you through all the sorrows.
All the songs, all the stars,

lines.cyr: сите очи плачат што те нема,

lines.cyr: што да речам, што да колнам,
